$comment: Reforged engine source pin for the Android integration. The Android build checks out THIS commit into reforged-engine/ and verifies it before applying any adaptation layer. Update procedure: change 'commit' (and 'commit_message'/'pinned_on') to a verified olcay commit, then re-run the Phase-3 adaptation validation. Never use a floating 'main' for production builds.
commit_message: feat(gameengine): put the skirmish AI's rating on an Elo scale
license: GPL-3.0-only (see LICENSE.md in the engine tree)
game_assets: NOT included. The user supplies their own legally-owned Zero Hour game data; the build never downloads or packages game assets.

third_party.note: Fetched by the engine's own Tools/vendor.sh at pinned commits, not by this manifest. Recorded here for traceability.

adaptation_layer.note: Android-specific changes applied to the checked-out engine at build time (never committed into the engine tree). Phase 3+ will add the C1-class CMake/bionic patch (verified applicable to this commit) and the re-derived C4-class game-library patch.
